description: This file defines the ColumnIterator class which implements iteration over worksheet columns in PhpSpreadsheet library. It provides methods to traverse columns between specified start and end points, retrieving column objects and managing iteration state.

classes.name: ColumnIterator
classes.description: An iterator class to traverse columns in a worksheet, supporting reset, seek, and iteration controls, based on specified start and end columns.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the iterator with a worksheet and optional start/end columns.

methods.name: resetStart
methods.description: Resets the starting column for iteration.

methods.name: resetEnd
methods.description: Resets the ending column for iteration.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Sets the current pointer to a specific column.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the iterator to the start column.

methods.name: key
methods.description: Returns the current column's string identifier.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next column.

methods.name: prev
methods.description: Moves the iterator to the previous column.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the current position is within the iteration range.
